{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id and sample_seq
print("Number of rows per patient:")
print(df.groupby('patient_id').size().value_counts())

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
# This ensures we keep the most recent test for each patient
df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Now compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline:")
print(df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

# Exclude sentinel values (e.g., -999.0) before computing mean
# The data dictionary says -999.0 is a sentinel value for missing data
valid_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'][df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]
mean_valid_baseline = valid_baseline.mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (excluding sentinel values): {mean_valid_baseline}")"}
